outgoing.name: Drosophila melanogaster
outgoing.excerpt: One of a class of genes involved in fruit fly embryonic development, called hedgehog genes, has been named " sonic hedgehog" after the character.

outgoing.name: Earth
outgoing.excerpt: The games: Sonic's home planet is Earth (although the name has varied slightly depending on minor regional differences).

outgoing.name: English language
outgoing.excerpt: Sonic is voiced by Jun'ichi Kanemaru in the Japanese version, and by Jason Griffith in the English version.

outgoing.name: Islam
outgoing.excerpt: The word Iblis relates to the equivalent of the devil, or Satan, in Islamic culture.

outgoing.name: Nintendo
outgoing.excerpt: The first game in the franchise was released in 1991 in order to provide Sega with a mascot to rival Nintendo's flagship character Mario.

outgoing.name: Oxygen
outgoing.excerpt: A slight continuity error in the Super Sonic levels is that Sonic can breath in space, obviously not needing oxygen, yet he can drown underwater.

outgoing.name: Pikachu
outgoing.excerpt: Sonic was also in the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade; the only other video game character to ever be in the parade was Pikachu.
